lines: Yesterday they were strangers on Instagram. Tonight, thirty-two of them stand in the mud of Verdel Ridge.
Eighteen for the Hegemony. Fourteen for the Concord.
The only machine gun on the ridge belongs to Masis.
The Concord brought a sapper, and a cook. Never underestimate the cook.
And now, the first real fight. The race for Verdel Ridge.
The first side to bring one hundred soldiers to the front takes the heights.
Three days of artillery on the enemy. A safer week for everyone on the winning side.
And the soldier who tips the balance becomes a hero.
Every morning, the Trench Gazette prints what happened on the line.
The weather. The new arrivals. Who was hurt, and who came home.
If your name is in it, you were there.
Every friend you bring is one more rifle.
